# Step - mark

`mark` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Records a named mark in the graph's journal for point-in-time recovery; needs a journal (see the book page Persistence).

## Forms

```text
mark(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.mark("before-import")   // error: no journal is registered
```

## See also

- [Marks](../../persistence/store_marks.md)
